comparison.objective: Wind back a screw-type brake piston with a two-pin tool, then seat two pads; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires aligning two tool pins, maintaining axial pressure while ratcheting, retracting a helical piston, and close-tolerance pad insertion. Candidate requires a smaller recessed bit, captive-screw manipulation, fine collar rotation, moved-socket reacquisition, and dynamic feedback tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the piston face retracted to ≤63 mm and both pads seated within tight position/orientation tolerances. Candidate requires the chosen setting retained and two impact cycles within energy, travel, force, velocity, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: This is the closest general tool-adjustment record, but its tested result is screw-driven clearance creation plus pad assembly, not iterative dynamic commissioning.
